24: Of Rabbi Yose: Later in [the chapter entitled] HaMafkid (Bava Metzia 37a): Two people who deposited [money] with one person; this one deposited one hundred dinars and that one deposited two hundred dinars. This one says, "The two hundred is mine"; and that one says, "The two hundred is mine," So the first teacher said, "He gives one hundred dinars to this one and one hundred dinars to that one. And the rest of the money will remain (in keeping) until Elijah comes [to decide]." Rabbi Yose said, "If so, what did the swindler lose" - and why should he confess; behold he received his [money]. "Rather, all of it will remain until Elijah comes," so that the swindler will lose [something]. And here too, it should remain.
